title: Unoffical Hypixel Zombies
description: Tries to add custom weapons that use perspective for a 3D look while playing hypixel zombies gamemode. Is a currently a w.i.p. texture pack.
body:
Inspired by Doom 2's UI, the Reource Pack holds a assortment of weapons I could remember. Using a 2D retro style for 3D. Since It doesnt use actual 3D models it should run fine on most computers. Taking advantage of Fp perspective to make a fun experience. ![All Avaliable weapons beside knife as of version 1.0 release](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/742b9d13d80a7d6c704347ae59e5b745d4a774a2.png)
(image is of 1.0 version of pack and may lack newer weapons)

The pack will work despite it staying on version format of 1.18+. (Well, until hypixel decides to have the entire server change to 1.26+)

Other than that mostly makes you feel amazing when playing from how it looks.
